note: TLS 1.3 loopback harness listener, POST-only MCP endpoint, header and body bounds, Host and Origin checks, per-source rate limits and lockout on the OAuth and session endpoints. The Remote Access listener (internal/remote) adds CP-49 bounds, public-name Host check and per-client limits. Missing: the UDS harness listener (CP-02 profile) and per-source connection limits on the MCP endpoint; FR-1.10 unknown methods answer HTTP 200 with -32601 instead of 404.

Both protocol eras through the MCP Go SDK in stateless mode, method allowlist, cache hints, Appendix B codes with reasonCode, correlationId, decisionId and the data.message text (FR-1.51), hold-mode keep-alives (progress or SSE comment), list_changed on listen streams after policy activation, request origin on events. Missing: progress relay from backends, MRTR Relay Profile, trace-context and clientInfo capture (FR-1.44, FR-1.45).

OAuth 2.1 authorization server (metadata, PKCE S256, resource, iss), pre-registered clients, sign-in by Session Approver accounts only (the Administrator is refused), Argon2id, rate limits, lockout with backoff and dummy verification. Remote Access adds RFC 7591 registration with operator approval and the RFC 8628 device grant. Missing: Client ID Metadata Document fetching with the CP-52 allowlist, mTLS and UDS peer credentials.

Session store with CP-18 lifetimes, per-principal limits, scope-to-template mapping, session API, refresh-token rotation with reuse detection, janitors, per-session lifetime and allowed templates for remote sessions; session taint is tracked by the policy layer. Sessions, taint state, rate windows and quotas are in memory and do not survive a restart.

Signed Policy Store (Ed25519, immutable revision files named by digest, signed active record with atomic activation), start-up import and fail-closed verification, publish with optional parent check, rollback as a new revision, diff, simulation from the journal or fixtures, /api/v1/policy* and smcpctl policy. Missing: draft workspace (FR-3.3), the other object types (Response, Observation, Anomaly Response policies), manifest ceiling checks at publication (SR-1-1, SR-1-3), stored fixture sets, import as draft, a crash-injection test of activation.

Default-deny decisions with deny-rule precedence, restrict-only session taint (TAINT_APPROVAL, TAINT_DENIED), sliding-window rates with CP-11 burst, per-session quotas, CP-12 evaluation bounds, filter obligations, profile and template intersection, Diff and Simulate. Missing: argument predicates (FR-3.6), approval floor by side-effect class (SR-1.18-1), decision explanation route (SR-1.19-1), secret-use obligations from the policy document; quotas count permitted decisions rather than completed calls.

Persisted one-use approvals bound per SR-1.18-2, CP-17 expiry, hold mode with keep-alives and the -31002 fallback carrying approvalId, expiresAt and approvalUrl, Approver accounts, /api/v1/approvals* with a watch stream, the harness status route, smcpctl approvals, desktop notification, G-13 console view, optional anomaly-band approval obligation. Approval events of remote calls carry the remote origin fields. Missing: anomaly evidence shown to the Approver (FR-3.18), the FR-3.25 recorded run with interactive Claude Code.

Session-scoped catalog per policy revision, updated in place on policy activation, unknown-tool rejection, approval hint (FR-1.50), metadata rule-set screen at presentation (FR-1.52). Catalogs built before a revision is suspended keep listing its tools until rebuilt (calls are refused).

Ordered request chain with mandatory and policy-obliged filters, CP-14 deadline, panic as block: schema-validate, size-limit, unicode-control, secret-fingerprint, path-canonicalize, url-canonicalize, injection-detect (tag only), the vault's secret-in-arguments filter; versioned rule sets with digests and measured error rates. Missing: data-class rules (SR-5.8-1), a second decision after a transforming filter (SR-5.12-1), request scoring as a stage.

stdio dispatch with CP-10 concurrency and queue bounds, CP-13 upstream timeout, bounded result reading, backend error mapping, suspension of a server on drift. Instances are shared across sessions; missing: per-session and per-call instances, cancellation propagation to the backend, progress relay, nesting-depth bound while reading.

Response chain: size-limit (size and depth), output-schema, content-type-gate, secret-fingerprint (redact or withhold with SECRET_LEAK), unicode-control, pii-detect, injection-marker, delimit-untrusted (FR-4.18), the vault's leak filter; provenance with disposition and tags. Missing: progress notifications through the chain (SR-5.9-1), response scoring as a stage.

One-use launch capability bound to correlation, decision, policy revision and tool; pre-launch and pre-release rechecks under the barrier; authorized committed with fsync before the capability and delivered before release; emergency stop and health gate refuse calls. SR-6.2-1 and SR-7.10-1 remain partial: the graph mirror is not consulted and not every recovery path is tested.

Recipes, package build (npm, PyPI, OCI or binary by digest, locked dependency closure, live probe, Appendix J manifest), minisign signing and offline verification, trust anchors scoped to risk classes, revocation entries, library scan and import with receipts, artifact re-verification before every launch; bootstrap packages the reference server. Missing: OCI registry library (FR-5.1), revocation feed staleness alert (SR-3-4), OCI probe without Podman, probe network isolation in Standalone.

Content-addressed artifact store, immutable revisions and registry states, enablement checks (Standalone refuses high risk, alias uniqueness, FR-1.49 collisions, expiry), drift detection at start and on list_changed that suspends the revision, /api/v1/packages and smcpctl package. Missing: era consistency at start (FR-5.17), classification overrides (SR-3.11-1); G-10 has enable, suspend and retire. A revision enabled while smcpd runs is launched at the next start.

Launch specification from configuration, rootless Podman launcher (Enforced) and subprocess launcher (Standalone), environment allowlist, bounded stderr, FR-5.27 shutdown sequence, reaping of leftover containers. Missing: launch specification from manifests, per-session and per-call instance scopes (FR-5.10), idle teardown and reuse (FR-5.11), restart and crash-loop suspension (FR-5.12).

Rootless Podman with read-only root, no capabilities, no-new-privileges, default seccomp, distinct user namespace per instance, network none, private namespaces, CP-24 cgroup limits, size-bounded tmpfs, grant-only mounts; packaging/linux/install-enforced.sh prepares identities, nftables and systemd units. Missing: Egress Broker attachment for sandboxed servers (network = egress is refused), AppArmor or SELinux profiles, the smcp-srv identity, systemd hardening exercised under a real systemd.

Runtime Monitor: cgroup sampling and inotify on memory and PID events, podman events, process_created, deviation (UNDECLARED_PROCESS, EXEC_INTO_INSTANCE), limit_breach, instance_killed and instance_exited evidence, alert and kill-instance actions. Missing: observation of file opens outside mounts and of network attempts (prevented, not observed), suspend-revision and suspend-session actions, rules from manifests.

Per-instance forward proxy (CONNECT with SNI check, plain HTTP), per-destination TLS-originating endpoints, grants by host, port, method and class, broker DNS with rebinding defense, reserved-address refusal, size, duration and rate limits, public-fetch profile, egress evidence, nftables confinement of a namespace, /api/v1/egress and smcpctl egress. S1 header injection on endpoint requests for the Secret Broker. Missing: grants from policy obligations, one-use egress capabilities (SR-5.16-1), outbound secret-fingerprint scanning (SR-5.8-2), attachment by the Podman launcher; advisory only in Standalone.

Age-encrypted versioned vault, master key in the macOS Keychain or passphrase-wrapped, owner-only file modes, rotation with CP-15 overlap and retirement, smcpctl secrets and /api/v1/secrets (metadata only). Missing: Linux kernel keyring and TPM key sources, master key under the E-22 key manager (SR-2.13-1).

Secret Use Policy file, S1 header injection through the Egress Broker, S2 per-call files, S3 per-instance files, S4 environment with waiver, secret_use evidence without values, HMAC leak fingerprints for the filters, leak suspension and resume, withdrawal on emergency stop. Missing: S1 for sandboxed servers (no egress in the sandbox yet), withdrawal of launch-time deliveries when the artifact check suspends a revision, Secret Use Policies inside the signed policy document, withdrawal on session end, evidence redaction by E-21 and E-29.

Signed hash-chained JSON Lines journal with group-committed fsync, crash recovery, signed anchor, verifier that follows evidence-key transitions, evidence export of closed segments, CP-27 unsigned-age rule, non-blocking observers feeding the graph mirror and observation. A failed write fails the endpoint closed. Missing: anchor rollback detection without off-host export, journal index for queries (FR-11.8), redaction of secret material in event details.

CP-53 server CA (365 days, path length 0, DNS and IP name constraints) and listener certificate (90 days, renewed at 30), hot reload, CA rotation with overlap, evidence-key rotation with signed transition, policy-signing key, package trust anchors, operator token, installation ID. Missing: TPM, Keychain or passphrase protection of private keys (FR-7.9), a client CA, separate keys for every purpose listed by the SRS. CP-53 CAs carry dNSName constraints only, so BoringSSL clients (native Claude Code, OpenCode) connect; smcpd warns when an older CA still has iPAddress constraints.

Health and Safety Monitor with one-second checks, fail-closed latch with 10 s recovery and acknowledgment of integrity causes, edge gate, loopback Prometheus metrics, rotating redacted diagnostic log, profile decision with the not-enforced label. The graph mirror and the Observation Store register health checks that report degraded, never fail-closed. Missing: health checks for the vault and the memory stage (FR-7.11).

smcpctl covers bootstrap, configuration, journal, policy, approvals, packages, trust, filters, secrets, egress, runtime, graph, observe, keys, backup, restore, upgrade, uninstall, remote, clients, lockdown and doctor. Control API with every Appendix C role (Administrator, Operator, Policy Author, Auditor, Researcher, Approver, Session Approver) from one route matrix, GET /api/v1/openapi.json describing every route, the filter workbench routes. Embedded React console with views G-01 to G-14 and their actions under a strict CSP, cookie sessions with a CSRF token and If-Match preconditions, one Playwright test per view on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with claims merged into the requirement report. Missing: publication of Audit Profiles, Observation Policies and Anomaly Response Policies from G-03, G-04 and G-06 (they produce [observation] configuration), principal management in G-11, per-object If-Match revisions, the two latest releases of each browser (FR-8.30), the G-04 usability measure.

Neo4j Community Edition 2026.05.0 integration, disabled unless [graph] enabled: ordered migrations with uniqueness constraints for every Appendix D label, engine settings and heap checks against CP-33, smcpctl graph config. Missing: nftables rules for the engine port and outbound denial, Unix-socket peer credentials, page-cache measurement and the FR-9.12 degradation order.

Data Access Service with a digest-checked template catalog, declared and bound parameters, server-side timeouts; the evidence mirror is an idempotent audit observer with journal catch-up and rebuild; /api/v1/graph* and canned queries. Missing: per-element operation allowlist (SR-4.3-1), priority classes, observation batching and backpressure (FR-9.4 to FR-9.6), mirroring of Policy Store and registry contents beyond IDs on events.

Observation Store tables partitioned by UTC day with one column per catalog parameter, write-once batches, DuckDB with zstd Parquet (cgo builds) or JSON Lines (release archives), aggregate queries with parity between backends, CP-25 retention. Missing: tiering and quotas; release archives built without cgo have no Parquet.

Graph retention in bounded batches, heap sampling with pressure flag, DuckDB memory limit, observation retention, encrypted online backup and verified restore (smcpctl backup, restore). Missing: memory manager and degradation order, tiering, scheduled backups, graph dump in backups and mirror rebuild on restore.

Observation Collector as an audit observer plus mandatory probes: one record per call with the computed catalog parameters, deterministic sampling, capture escalation, drop counting, meta-metrics; never blocks a call. Missing: per-stage and per-rule spans with CPU time (FR-10.2), observables from the other elements, published Observation Policies, S3 payload capture, session records.

Welford statistics with optional decay, log1p and Box-Cox transforms, t-digest median and MAD, category and transition surprise, learning exclusions, sealed snapshots, drift reports, promotion and rollback, integrity events. Missing: baseline contexts and thresholds from published policies (G-04 and G-05 produce configuration, not policy objects).

Digest-verified atomic snapshot load, z and robust z with sigma floors, max-|z| combination naming the feature, CP-30 bands and uncharacterized, asynchronous alerts and capture escalation, optional synchronous approval and withhold obligations (off by default). Missing: per-band Anomaly Response Policies from the policy document; anomaly evidence on the approval record; uncharacterized contexts are treated as normal.

Campaign life cycle with clocks and quota, exports in Parquet, CSV, JSON Lines and GraphML with per-dataset HMAC pseudonyms, dictionary, manifest and checksums, CSV formula neutralization. Researcher accounts create, submit and stop campaigns and export their datasets. Missing: a pseudonymization key issued by E-22, Parquet in builds without cgo.

smcp-session, smcp-stdio (both eras, UDS dialing) and smcp-connect (binary and npm) with the CP-43 credential file; smcpctl clients setup, lockdown and doctor for the seven local clients; Tailscale Funnel and Cloudflare tunnel drivers. The real-agent suite passes Claude Code, OpenCode and Goose; Codex CLI fails the approval scenario; Hermes, Gemini CLI and Grok Build are not run (not installed, no model credentials, no public CLI). Missing: setup and lockdown runs at pinned versions (FR-15.8 for the adapters), dated cloud-agent runs (FR-15.9), nftables rules on remote enable (SR-4.14-1).
